Terms of Use

Last Updated: October 11, 2023

1. Acceptance of Terms

By accessing or using the services of FreeIPTVPlayer.net, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these terms. If you do not accept these terms in full, please do not use our services.

2. Description of Service

FreeIPTVPlayer.net offers a platform that enables users to access and watch IPTV streams through our player. We do not host, produce, or control the content. Our service acts as a medium that provides users with the tools to play these streams.

3. Registration and Account Security

To access certain features, users may be required to create an account. Users agree to provide accurate, current, and complete information during the registration process and to update such information to keep it accurate, current, and complete.

4. Premium Accounts

For a monthly fee, users can upgrade to a premium account, enjoying benefits such as an ad-free experience and additional features. The amount of this monthly fee is subject to change, and current premium users will be notified of any changes via the email associated with their account. Billing occurs monthly. There are no refunds, even if you cancel your subscription before the month's end. Premium benefits will remain active until the end of the billing cycle.

5. Usage Guidelines and Prohibited Activities

While users have the freedom to stream, any illegal activities, including unauthorized streaming or distributing copyrighted content, are strictly forbidden. Users found to be engaging in illegal activities will face account termination and may be reported to relevant authorities.

6. Service Availability

Although we strive to provide a 99.9% uptime for our website, occasional technical glitches or maintenance may result in temporary service interruptions. Additionally, while we offer the platform to play IPTV streams, we have no control over the streams themselves or their availability. We're not responsible for any impact these downtimes might have or for unavailability or interruptions in the streams.

7. Content and IPTV Streams

Our service utilizes channels and streaming URLs from the iptv-org GitHub repository. We neither endorse nor have control over this content. As stated in the repository:

"No video files are stored in this repository. The repository simply contains user-submitted links to publicly available video stream URLs, which to the best of our knowledge have been intentionally made publicly by the copyright holders. If any links in these playlists infringe on your rights as a copyright holder, they may be removed by sending a pull request or opening an issue. However, note that we have no control over the destination of the link, and just removing the link from the playlist will not remove its contents from the web. Linking does not directly infringe copyright because no copy is made on the site providing the link, and thus this is not a valid reason to send a DMCA notice to GitHub. To remove this content from the web, you should contact the web host that's actually hosting the content (not GitHub, nor FreeIPTVPlayer.net)."

https://github.com/iptv-org/iptv#legal

Concerns about licensing, copyrights, or content quality should be directed to the respective GitHub repo or the web host actually hosting the content.

Ads displayed on our platform are not endorsed by FreeIPTVPlayer.net. Interactions with these ads are at the user's own risk. We disclaim any responsibility for any harm resulting from such interactions.

Disputing charges without first attempting to resolve the issue with our support will result in immediate account termination. Concerns regarding streams should be directed to the iptv-org GitHub repository.
